# Valid loop exits skip effects in the remainder of the body, including nested braces.
while 1 { break; { 1 / 0 }; 9 }; 7 => 7
let n = 0; while n < 2 { n = n + 1; continue; { 1 / 0 }; 9 }; n => 2
while 1 { match 1 { 1 => { break; }, _ => 1 / 0 }; 9 }; 7 => 7
let n = 0; while n < 1 { n = n + 1; if 1 { continue; } else { 1 / 0 }; 9 }; n => 1
while 1 { break; { 7 }; 1 => expected closing brace
